# Vert.x Http Proxy

Source: https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vertx-http-proxy/blob/main/README.md


# Vert.x Http Proxy

Vert.x Http Proxy is a reverse proxy based on Vert.x, it aims to implement reusable reverse proxy logic to focus on
higher concerns.
